criteria.title: Evidence and interpretation stay distinct
criteria.description: Observed facts are linked to the supplied evidence, semantic interpretation is identified as evaluation, and user behavior not present in evidence is not asserted.

criteria.title: Source positions and applicability stay distinct
criteria.description: Each applied reference retains its own source item and position; normative, informative, advisory, and project-binding force are not merged or silently promoted.

criteria.title: Dialog behavior uses the right evidence
criteria.description: DOM/accessibility evidence supports role/name, keyboard interaction evidence supports focus behavior, and screenshots support only visible presentation and obscuration claims.

criteria.title: Evaluation and QA ownership stay bounded
criteria.description: UI/UX evaluation does not change TC PASS/FAIL or score Product Risk, does not seize live browser ownership, and routes follow-up or additional observation to the correct owner.

criteria.title: Findings and false positives are controlled
criteria.description: A Finding is linked only when a distinct downstream QA action is required; an additional-observation request to the current owner is separate. No-issue/out-of-scope rows have no Finding. An advisory heuristic may support a bounded expert UX concern, but is not a binding defect unless separately adopted or required by an applicable Authority. The result closes each selected aspect.
